about_the_game:
Items that change the tactical orbment cover's design.

Chibi Character Cover: Estelle
Chibi Character Cover: Joshua
Chibi Character Cover: Scherazard
Chibi Character Cover: Olivier
Chibi Character Cover: Kloe
Chibi Character Cover: Agate
Chibi Character Cover: Tita

*Open [DLC] under [Item] tab in the main menu and select new items to receive them.
*After receiving items, apply them via [Change Cover] in the Orbment menu.
*Sora no Kiseki the 1st base game (sold separately) required to access this content. Please update and install the most recent patch if necessary.
*This content is included in the Sora no Kiseki the 1st Season Pass. Beware of duplicate purchases.
